_comment: Machine-readable formula registry produced by the sitewide math audit (docs/audits/math-formula-audit-2026-07-30.md). One record per NUMERICAL CONCEPT, not per arithmetic expression — the point is to answer 'who owns this number and who else computes it', so a future duplicate implementation is visible as a diff against this file rather than as a bug report months later. Pinned by tests/audit/test_formula_registry.py.

_fields.concept: what is being calculated, in product language
_fields.units: the scale/unit the number is on
_fields.duplicates: other implementations of the same concept, with disposition

duplicates.note: The legacy scraper composite, ~1.131x the board. Now reachable ONLY as values.rawComposite (the UI's explicit 'Raw' mode). Finding H1 removed it from every board-scale fallback chain.
Fundamental value, not market value. Never writes rankDerivedValue.

concepts.concept: Per-row values bundle (overall / finalAdjusted / displayValue / rawComposite)
concepts.units: board points for overall/finalAdjusted/displayValue; composite points for rawComposite
concepts.invariant: The three board-named keys are the board value or None. They are NEVER seeded from the composite. Pinned by tests/api/test_value_bundle_scale_contract.py.

consumers: every page; the frontend consumes stamps verbatim

duplicates.note: Assigned only to rows the backend deliberately left unranked (past rank 800). Suppressed for picks and under a valuation overlay. Not a ranking engine — no value is recomputed.
Percentile-of-source-ranks mapped onto a target value distribution, plus a power-law sparse fallback. Feeds canonicalSiteValues, which the canonical pipeline then re-ranks. Finding M8.
Mirrors only the OFFENSE rank-form constants; the backend is scope-aware (separate IDP pair). Finding M3.

duplicates.impl: src/model_registry/holdout.py p = i/(n-1) over a 400-cap native pool
duplicates.note: The promotion gate scores candidate curves under a different percentile convention than production serves. Finding M2.

concepts.measured: 716 of 6251 per-source votes (11.5%) land on the flattened tail at N=500; OVERALL_RANK_LIMIT is 800, so 300 published ranks sit past the point the inputs resolve.

concepts.invariant: Structural double-count guard: from_basis == to_basis is a no-op, so a second call cannot compound. The ceiling bound is now a strictly increasing squash, so distinct source votes stay distinct.
concepts.rejectedAlternative: Rank-space shift (scripts/audit/fit_ktc_te_rank_shift.py). Bounded by construction but reproduces KTC's measured TE ratio worse: mean abs error 0.175 vs 0.090. Recorded, not adopted.

concepts.canonical: src/api/data_contract.py (blend + year discount + rookie tethering) -> rankDerivedValue

duplicates.note: Was reached for every current_season+1 pick — half the board — with a valid contract loaded. Finding C1.
Only to_display_value is a live export from that module.
Different formula against identical band thresholds. Finding C3.

concepts.invariant: Two languages, one formula, one shared fixture. Neither test may hardcode its own expectation.

concepts.canonical: src/intel/signals.py::signal_strength (single primary window) + velocity (ratio between windows)

duplicates.note: Nested windows: one event an hour old contributed 3+2+1=6. signals.py had documented it as retired; it was still the primary board sort key. Finding C2.

concepts.invariant: Nested time windows are NEVER summed. Recency is expressed as a ratio between windows, which cannot double-count because division by a superset cancels shared events.

concepts.canonical: NONE — three legitimately different concepts, see note

duplicates.note: Group leave-out against a real lineup solve. The only aggregation that legitimately claims lineup awareness.
No flex, no replacement level, no optimizer.

duplicates.disposition: SIMPLE SUM, excludes picks (the FE fallback includes them)

concepts.concept: How many starters a team fields at a position
Percentile of a value within a population

duplicates.disposition: (below + 0.5*equal)/n — max (n-0.5)/n; makes the 0.85 cohort bar unreachable at n=2
same as sharp; can never return 1.0
index via banker's rounding — non-monotonic index steps

duplicates.note: Python round() is banker's, JS Math.round is half-up. Finding H4.

concepts.canonical: tests/fixtures/signal_parity_cases.json — a shared rule table read by BOTH implementations
concepts.note: Debt register D3 lists this as 'implemented twice, no parity test'. That is STALE — the shared fixture and both parity tests already exist. No work was done here; the register was corrected.
Never writes rankDerivedValue. Compared against the market board, never merged into it.

Divisor 8.0 is a fossil of the ~10-site era; with the deliberate 2-source model confidence is structurally capped at 0.594. Known debt D15, measured in docs/open-modeling-decisions.md section 3, deliberately deferred.
